title: How the dashboard works
subtitle: A quick reference for the screens you have access to.
intro: Everything you need to run your guest WiFi lives here — from checking who's online right now to deciding exactly who gets to connect. Every screen listed below is one you can open; tap any of them to go straight there.

group.overview: A quick, real-time read on how your guest WiFi is doing right now.
group.engagement: Reach the people connected to your WiFi — surveys, offers, and a branded welcome.
group.access-policy: Control who can connect, how much bandwidth they get, and when WiFi is available.
group.devices-team: Keep track of your hardware and shared accounts, and control what your staff can do.
group.network: The plumbing behind your guest WiFi — addresses, separation, forwarding, and call quality.
group.security: What your guest WiFi is protected against, and one place to block websites, addresses and guests.
group.operations: Day-to-day running — and what to check when something breaks.
group.support-logs: Get help, and see the record of what happened.

feature.dashboard: Who's online right now, whether your connection is healthy, and anything that needs your attention.
feature.users: Every guest connected right now. Search by name, see their device and data used, or end someone's session.
feature.reports: Guest numbers over time, and the full list you can export as a CSV.
feature.alerts: Get told when something goes wrong — before a guest has to tell you.
feature.campaigns: Surveys and offers shown to guests as they connect, plus the page they land on afterwards.
feature.portal: Design the sign-in screen guests see — logo, colours, headline, languages and sign-in methods.
feature.vouchers: Printable one-time codes guests redeem instead of signing in the usual way.
feature.policies: The speed cap, device and time limits each guest's next session starts under, plus access tiers.
feature.whitelist: The guest numbers and devices you allow when this property is closed to everyone else.
feature.mac-auth: Fixed equipment — a front-desk tablet, a POS terminal, a printer — that connects on its own.
feature.business-hours: The days and hours guests can sign in, and what they see when you're closed.
feature.devices: Your own network hardware and whether it's online, plus every guest device connected to it.
feature.teams: Shared desk or room accounts with one login and a pooled data allowance.
feature.agents: Add your staff, and choose exactly which parts of this dashboard each of them can see.
feature.dhcp: The pool of addresses handed out to guest devices on your network. You'll rarely need to touch this.
feature.vlans: Keeps guest WiFi walled off from your own staff and office equipment.
feature.port-forwarding: Advanced. Lets one device be reached from the internet. Most venues never need this.
feature.voip: Sends voice and video calls ahead of browsing when the network is busy. It reorders traffic; it cannot add capacity your line does not have.
feature.isp-details: Your internet line — who provides it, how it's performing, and what happens if it drops.
feature.security: What your WiFi is protected against today, and what this platform cannot do yet.
feature.blocking: The websites, internet addresses and guests you have blocked from your guest WiFi, in one place.
feature.firewall: Which devices on your network may reach which addresses, checked in order — and applying those rules to your router.
feature.web-filtering: Block whole kinds of website, such as adult or gambling sites, and switch it on router by router.
feature.debugging: Tests you can run when something's slow or broken, including resetting one guest's session.
feature.tickets: Ask us for help. We can see your setup, so you don't have to explain it from scratch.
feature.admin-logs: Who signed in to this dashboard, and what they changed.
feature.network-activity: The record of guest connections and sign-in attempts you may need to keep for compliance.
